facts.business: PB Fintech Limited operates as an insurance and financial services platform in India, providing insurance distribution and related services through its subsidiaries.
key_risks: Energy prices, trade-policy changes and a slower global rate cycle remain the principal external risks to disposable incomes and financial conditions.
Inflation above target in several major economies keeping global funding conditions relatively tight.
Insurance penetration remains low at 3.7% of GDP compared to global average of 7.3%.
Households need products designed around irregular incomes, affordability constraints, pre-existing conditions and limited familiarity with insurance.
